actions.action: Check soil moisture an inch down with a finger before watering
If soil dries within a few days, soak pot in a basin of room-temperature water for 15-20 minutes and let drain
Empty the saucer about 30 minutes after watering
If segments don't firm up in two weeks or stems turn soft/black, slide plant out and inspect roots
Trim mushy or dark dead roots if found
Place in bright indirect light away from direct sun and cold drafts

reason: The answer correctly identifies long-term underwatering with compacted soil, but it makes repotting (the fix the poster used) conditional on root rot, focusing instead on soak-watering, so the advice is only partial; nothing in it is harmful.
